questions.stem: What would happen if carbon dioxide was not removed from the blood?

options.text: Blood would carry less glucose to cells
Blood would clot more easily, blocking blood vessels
Blood would become too alkaline and cells would swell
Blood would become too acidic, affecting enzyme function

questions.explanation: Carbon dioxide dissolves in blood to form carbonic acid. If it accumulates, the blood becomes too acidic, which changes the pH and affects how enzymes work, disrupting homeostasis.
